capture.blocking_verdict: The isolated physical canary captured useful SPEC-032 strict-gate evidence for stale-evidence exclusion, tuple-mismatch exclusion, evidence-absent sandboxing, and reload revalidation. It did not complete the full promotable matrix: R001 over-ceiling/uncatalogued heartbeat transitions were not safely executable through the shipped physical CLI, R002 missing-admitted-tuple was not physically exercised, and R003 hot-enable fail-closed reload from gate-off to gate-on was not physically exercised.
capture.conformance_promotion: not-promoted; no specs/CONFORMANCE.json row is updated from this partial artifact.
